findings.reason: the plan must either state that the moved helpers take the heading end from the parser's replaced-span offsets (dropping `str.find("")`) or name these sites among the exemptions, or its own package-wide gate is unsatisfiable at the head it declares.
findings.text: §17 moves `_section_heading`/`_wrapper_section_heading` into `reckon/_plan_html.py`; both locate the heading's closing tag with `html_text.find("", …)` (reckon/_store.py:925 and :955), and the census rule §17 specifies reports "every string literal spelling a heading tag … searched with `str.find`", so those two sites arrive in the destination module and the done-when's "exactly the span parser …, the four named exemptions …, and nothing else" cannot hold

findings.reason: the substance is right (three grammars in `_apply_set`, `_require_authored_section_fields` and `_apply_collapse_section`) and the head target of four holds, so only the stated figure is corrected, not the design.
findings.text: §16 states `grep -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' reckon/_store.py` "reads nine at the base"; the grep reads 10 (four slug/anchor lines at 1265/1269/1273/1277, plus six lines for the three section grammars at 2534/2537, 3135/3138, 3191/3195), so the quoted base figure is off by one

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the private `_StructuredSectionSpanParser` (reckon/_plan_html.py:44) is read once behind the public `plan_headings` records, and `_section_digests` and the coverage predicate stay module-private, so substantial behaviour sits behind small interfaces rather than a spread of wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — every duplicate the plan touches names the owner to extend: three store section-id grammars onto `_schema.is_section_identity`, heading walks onto the parser, the landing-comment prefix onto `plan_review.RUN_COMMENT_PREFIX`, the classification word onto `_schema`, and `landed_section_ids` is re-homed not doubled.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1477, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §16 adds +1 (`strip_tags`), §17 adds +2 (`plan_headings`, the machinery-element predicate), §18 adds +1 (the classification predicate), each naming what it retires or why nothing can be, and the counter counts only function/class defs (`DEFINITIONS` at reckon/interface_counts.py:38 excludes assignments) so the three new constants are correctly uncounted.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the named repo and cites mechanisms I opened and confirmed: `_TAG_RE`/`count_open_decisions` (reckon/_plan_html.py:1506,1514), `roadmap._SECTION_WORD_RE` (reckon/roadmap.py:170), the five `== "implementable"` readers plus the `_plan_html.py:353` progress figure, and the lone `landed_section_ids` importer (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:60).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §17 moves thirteen heading helpers into `reckon/_plan_html.py` but its done-when declares that module clean of heading-tag literals beyond the span parser and four exemptions, and the moved `_section_heading`/`_wrapper_section_heading` carry `str.find("")`.
